title: RTT/Inside Substrate Triad Roles Schema
description: Defines triad role metadata for RTT/Inside enterprise identity substrates.

triad_role.description: Assigned triad role for the identity or service within RTT/Inside semantics.

triad_origin.description: Identity substrate layer that asserted or inferred the triad role.

triad_confidence.description: Confidence score representing how strongly the substrate layer supports the assigned triad role.

triad_timestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the triad role was generated or last updated.
